name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Wind Chime With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood, providing durability and a warm, elegant appearance.
    - Wooden thickness: 5mm, sturdy yet lightweight for hanging decoration.
    - The wind chime structure includes:
                   +) Wooden top base.
                   +) Multiple aluminum tubes that create soothing chime sounds when moved by the wind.
                   +) Nylon hanging strings for durability and flexibility.
                   +) Crystal charm (round or heart shape) that reflects light beautifully.
                   +) Custom wooden hanging piece printed with personalized design.
    - Carefully crafted components ensure both visual appeal and pleasant sound resonance.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden hanging piece:
                   +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm.
                   +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
                   +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm.
    - Total hanging length of wind chime: 58 cm.
    - Diameter of top wooden base: 10.5 cm.
    - Crystal charm size: 3 cm.
    - Diameter of each metal tube: 1.5 cm.
    📌 Note: The wooden hanging piece dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - High-resolution UV printing applied directly onto the wooden surface.
    - Supports 2-sided printing, allowing artwork or text to appear on both front and back sides.
    - The printing process ensures clear details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting durability without fading.
    - Smooth finishing enhances the natural wood texture while preserving printed artwork quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative wind chime ornament that produces gentle, relaxing sounds when moved by the breeze.
    - Ideal for hanging in gardens, balconies, patios, porches, windows, or indoor spaces.
    - Adds a peaceful and calming atmosphere to homes or outdoor environments.
    - The crystal charm reflects sunlight, creating a beautiful light-catching effect.
    - Serves as both a decorative piece and a meaningful personalized keepsake.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, memorial gifts, or housewarming occasions.
    - Ideal for anyone who appreciates personalized décor and relaxing ambient ornaments.
    - A thoughtful decorative piece that combines sentimental value, craftsmanship, and soothing sound.
    - Suitable for decorating both indoor and outdoor living spaces🎁

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
